# Wedding Waitress

> Wedding Waitress is an event management platform for couples and vendors: guest lists, table planning, QR code seating charts, place cards, dietary requirements, running sheets, DJ/MC questionnaires, invitations, and a Live Slideshow guest lookup at the venue.

## Pages

- [Home](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/): Product overview and sign up.
- [How It Works](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/how-it-works): Step-by-step walkthrough of the platform.
- [Features](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/features): Full feature list.
- [Products](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/products): Individual product pages.
- [Pricing](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/pricing): One-time couple plans and vendor monthly subscriptions.
- [FAQ](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/faq): Common questions.
- [Contact](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/contact): Get in touch.
- [Blog](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/blog): Articles on QR seating charts, wedding planning, and signage.

## Core features

- [My Events](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/my-events): Create and manage multiple events with countdowns.
- Event Budget Planner: Plan and manage the event budget from the connected dashboard.
- [Tables](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/tables): Create tables and assign guests via drag-and-drop.
- [Guest List](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/guest-list): Manage guests, RSVPs, dietary, and invitations.
- [QR Code Seating Chart](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/qr-code-seating-chart): Branded QR codes guests scan to find their seat.
- [Full Seating Chart](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/full-seating-chart): Printable A4 master seating chart.
- [Individual Table Charts](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/individual-table-charts): Per-table seating charts.
- [Name Place Cards](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/name-place-cards): 300 DPI printable place cards.
- [Invitations & Cards](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/invitations-cards): Designer invitation cards with delivery.
- [Dietary Requirements](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/dietary-requirements): Kitchen-ready dietary chart.
- [Floor Plan](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/floor-plan): Ceremony and reception floor plans.
- [Live Slideshow](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/live-slideshow): Self-service venue guest lookup slideshow.
- [Running Sheet](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/running-sheet): Event run sheet for vendors.
- [DJ/MC Questionnaire](https://weddingwaitress.com.au/dj-mc-questionnaire): DJ/MC briefing form.
